venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — Faulkner’s 11, White’s nickel
dek: What Saturday looked like. Faulkner in shotgun with three wide and Baugh. White in nickel, sitting off. The short game is the story both ways.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner wants width: shotgun, three wide, Baugh, one tight end. White wants nickel: two linebackers, extra DB on the slot, stand-up edges. FAU did not beat the front. They beat the cushion.

offense.body:
The depth chart is 12 — two tight ends, Singleton and Wilson outside, Baugh in the backfield. What we saw Saturday is 11. One back. One tight end. Three wide. Shotgun. Two receivers to each side, or trips. Singleton starts. Brown does the damage. Faulkner wanted the field stretched.

They huddle. They get the call, then they play.

First down belongs to Baugh. Inside zone when the hole is there. Bounce when it clogs — that is the long one. Power when they smell the end zone — a puller, pads down, through the pile.

Then the throw is short. Hitch to Brown. The 49 is a catch at midfield and a missed tackle. He runs. Wilson moves the sticks the same way. Stockton’s is the fade at the pylon. Harpring shows up in the middle — the tight end is in the pass game. Clark on a drag.

When they take the top off, it is a go. Abrams down the sideline. Brown later, same side. After Baugh has already won. They do not live there.

The changeups: nobody in the backfield at the 3, Philo keeps. Brown as a runner. Clark finishes drives. Jones Jr. closes.
bullets: Card is 12. Saturday look is 11 — shotgun, three wide, Baugh.
They huddle. First down is Baugh: zone, bounce, power.
The throw is hitch and fade. Brown’s 49 is YAC. Stockton is the pylon.
The go is the changeup: Abrams, then Brown, down the sideline.
Empty keep. Brown as a runner. Clark to close.

defense.body:
White’s look is nickel. Four down. Woods and McCray as the stand-up edges. Graham and Chiles at linebacker. An extra DB on the slot — that is Kanye Clark. Thornton and Coleman at safety. Built for spread. FAU is spread.

He rushes four and waits. The ball comes out late, Coleman takes it. Interior heat, a duck, Johnson high-points it.

The leak is the cushion. Corners sit off. FAU lives on hitch, flat, and out. Not bombs. That is how a defense gets two takeaways and still gives up long drives.

The points they gave: Ervin in the phone booth — packed box, still in. Veltkamp around the edge — contain lost. Valsin on the fade — Flowers loses the back line.

Graham is the linebacker filling the hole. McCloud is the interior. Bett strips it late.

The front is right. The short game and the edge are how they moved it. Campbell will go at the slot and the edge.

specials.body: Fourth-and-4. They leave the offense out there, then Durkin from 53. Clean. 17–0. No punt.
bullets: Durkin 53 on fourth-and-4. They took the points.

nextWeek.look: They will go hurry-up. Florida’s look is shotgun 11 and nickel. Run it on first down. Take away the short throw. Slot and edge.
